answer: Proof of Stake offers robust Sybil resistance by requiring agents to lock capital to validate transactions, ensuring every identity has a tangible cost proportional to its influence. Just as a walnut falls from a tree to establish a position within a grove, each agent roots its authority in economic collateral. This prevents an attacker from flooding the digital meadow with fake nodes, as the cost of acquiring sufficient stake renders the creation of mass fraudulent identities prohibitively expensive.
